wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=California Baptist Lancers |sport=Basketball |image=California Baptist Lancers wordmark.svg |image_size=200 |conference=Western Athletic Conference |division= |short_conf=WAC |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=13–10 |conf_record=6–6 |head_coach=[[Rick Croy]] |hc_year=8th |assoc_coach=Hardy Asprilla |asst_coach1=Adam Jacobsen |asst_coach2=Geoffrey McIntosh |stadium=[[CBU Events Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 WAC men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 California Baptist Lancers men's basketball team''' represented [[California Baptist University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Lancers, led by eighth-year head coach [[Rick Croy]], played their home games at the [[CBU Events Center]] in [[Riverside, California]] as members of the [[Western Athletic Conference]]. The season marked CBU's third year of a four-year transition period from Division II to Division I. As a result, the Lancers were not eligible for NCAA postseason play, but could participate in the [[2021 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]]. They were eligible to play in the [[CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|CIT]] or [[College Basketball Invitational|CBI]], but not invited. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 California Baptist
